name: context-aware-dev-assistant-vscode
description: Privacy-preserving, opt-in IDE context capture for the local Context-Aware Dev Assistant

contextAwareDevAssistant.backendBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the local backend API (must be reachable from this machine).

contextAwareDevAssistant.requestTimeoutM.description: HTTP timeout for backend requests in milliseconds.

contextAwareDevAssistant.editEventThrott.description: Minimum interval between document_edit events for the same file.

contextAwareDevAssistant.useDevConsentBo.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. When true, uses POST /sessions with bootstrap_consent=true instead of POST /consent + POST /sessions. Keep false unless you intentionally enable backend ALLOW_DEV_CONSENT_BOOTSTRAP.

scripts.test: tsx --test test/unit/pathHash.test.ts test/unit/eventBuilder.test.ts test/unit/backendClient.test.ts test/unit/captureDefaults.test.ts test/unit/sessionGate.test.ts
